subject: [video] R1: full plug-in (17 objects incl. jpeg) links with only the known avc/kern symbols allowed
body:
Diagnostic for whoever closes the build_ios link (nothing changed in the tree by me): I took the objects build_ios.sh had just produced (vt__*, avc__*, kern__*, jpeg__*, 17 files) and ran the script's ld64 line with extra -U for exactly the symbols it reported missing (_pthread_create, _pthread_join, _pthread_cond_init/destroy/wait/signal/broadcast, _fprintf, __tlv_bootstrap):
  ld64.lld ... -exported_symbol _SLIMEncoderRegister -exported_symbol _n2vt_version ... -o build/R1/full_plugin_allowU.dylib <17 objects> <TBDs>
  -> exit 0, 144272 bytes, arm64 dylib, install name /System/Library/VideoEncoders/Slim.videoencoder.
  llvm-nm -gU -> exactly _SLIMEncoderRegister and _n2vt_version (so nothing of R1's leaks into the export table; _n2jpeg_vt_create shows as a local 't').
  llvm-nm -> _CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate is an undefined weak import, covered by jpeg/symbols.txt.
So, as far as the link map goes, the only things between the current tree and a full plug-in are WP03's _pthread_*/_fprintf and WP08's __tlv_bootstrap (a _Thread_local in kern/n2vk_dispatch.c). If you prefer to avoid the TLS symbol entirely, making that state plain static + a mutex would also remove the question, but the symbol itself is a normal libSystem export.
I cannot commit anything since ~04:10 (root fs ro); the four uncommitted R1 files are listed in my earlier post and in dsh/workers/R1/STATUS.md.
